info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Package mq is queue and stream admin for your org: create them, watch them drain, ack what you pulled.

get.summary: Reports whether the message plane behind this surface answers.
get.description: Reports whether the message plane behind this surface answers.

get.summary: Returns the broker's identity and the org's stream count.
get.description: Returns the broker's identity and the org's stream count.

get.summary: Returns the org's streams, name-ordered, with their live state.
get.description: Returns the org's streams, name-ordered, with their live state.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the streams returned (1–1000, default 100).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset skips that many streams, name-ordered.

post.summary: Creates a durable stream in the org's namespace and returns it.
post.description: Creates a durable stream in the org's namespace and returns it.

delete.summary: Removes a stream with all its messages and consumers.
delete.description: Removes a stream with all its messages and consumers. Irreversible.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name is the stream name, from the path.

get.summary: Returns one stream's configuration and live state.
get.description: Returns one stream's configuration and live state.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name is the stream name, from the path.

put.summary: Reconfigures an existing stream; the path names the stream, and the immutable fields (storage, retention) must restate what they are.
put.description:
Reconfigures an existing stream; the path names the stream, and the
immutable fields (storage, retention) must restate what they are.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name is the stream name, unique within the org (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores).

get.summary: Reads stored messages without a consumer: by sequence, by newest on a subject, or walking a subject forward from a sequence.
get.description:
Reads stored messages without a consumer: by sequence, by newest on a
subject, or walking a subject forward from a sequence.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name is the stream name, from the path.

parameters.name: seq
parameters.description: Seq reads the message at this sequence (with next_by_subject: the walk's start).

parameters.name: last_by_subject
parameters.description: LastBySubject reads the newest message on this org-relative subject.

parameters.name: next_by_subject
parameters.description: NextBySubject walks forward from seq collecting messages on this org-relative subject (wildcards supported).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps a next_by_subject walk (1–1000, default 100).

delete.summary: Erases one message by sequence; the sequence gap remains.
delete.description: Erases one message by sequence; the sequence gap remains.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name is the stream name, from the path.

parameters.name: seq
parameters.description: Seq is the message's stream sequence, from the path.

post.summary: Removes messages from a stream, leaving its consumers in place.
post.description: Removes messages from a stream, leaving its consumers in place.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name is the stream name, from the path.

get.description: Returns a stream's consumers, name-ordered, with delivery state.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the consumers returned (1–1000, default 100).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset skips that many consumers, name-ordered.

post.summary: Creates a durable pull consumer on a stream and returns it.
post.description: Creates a durable pull consumer on a stream and returns it.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Stream is the stream name, from the path.

delete.summary: Removes a consumer and its delivery state; unacknowledged messages stay in the stream.
delete.description:
Removes a consumer and its delivery state; unacknowledged messages
stay in the stream.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Stream is the stream name, from the path.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name is the consumer name, from the path.

get.summary: Returns one consumer's configuration and delivery state.
get.description: Returns one consumer's configuration and delivery state.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Stream is the stream name, from the path.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name is the consumer name, from the path.

post.description:
Pulls the consumer's next batch. Delivered messages are acknowledged on
delivery — the broker will not redeliver what this call returns; an empty
wait answers 408.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Stream is the stream name, from the path.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name is the consumer name, from the path.

max_age.description: MaxAge caps message age, e.g. "24h" or "7d"; "0" (default) is unlimited.

max_bytes.description: MaxBytes caps the stream's total stored bytes; -1 (default) is unlimited.

max_msg_size.description: MaxMsgSize caps one message's size in bytes; -1 (default) is the broker's limit.

max_msgs.description: MaxMsgs caps the number of stored messages; -1 (default) is unlimited.

name.description: Name is the stream name, unique within the org (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores).

num_replicas.description: Replicas is the number of stream replicas (1–5); this plane runs 1.

retention.description: Retention is the retention policy: limits (default), interest, or workqueue.

storage.description: Storage is the storage backend: file (default) or memory.

subjects.description: Subjects are the org-relative subjects bound to this stream (wildcards supported). Default: the stream name.

ack_floor.description: AckFloor is the highest contiguously acknowledged sequence pair.

created.description: Created is when the consumer was created.

delivered.description: Delivered is the highest delivered sequence pair.

num_ack_pending.description: AckPending is the number of delivered, not yet acknowledged messages.

num_pending.description: Pending is the number of messages yet to be delivered.

num_redelivered.description: Redelivered is the number of messages currently being redelivered.

num_waiting.description: Waiting is the number of pull requests waiting for messages.

stream_name.description: Stream is the stream this consumer reads.

ack_policy.description: Ack is the acknowledgment policy: explicit (default), all, or none.

ack_wait.description: AckWait is how long the broker waits for an ack before redelivering, e.g. "30s" (default).

deliver_policy.description: Deliver is where delivery starts: all (default), last, new, by_start_sequence, by_start_time, or last_per_subject.

description.description: Description says what this consumer is for.

durable_name.description: Name is the durable consumer name (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores).

filter_subject.description: Filter delivers only messages on this org-relative subject (wildcards supported).

max_ack_pending.description: MaxAckPending caps unacknowledged messages in flight (default 1000).

max_deliver.description: MaxDeliver caps delivery attempts per message; -1 (default) is unlimited.

opt_start_seq.description: StartSeq is the starting sequence for deliver_policy by_start_sequence.

opt_start_time.description: StartTime is the starting instant for deliver_policy by_start_time.

replay_policy.description: Replay is the replay pacing: instant (default) or original.

status.description: Status is ok when the message plane answers, degraded otherwise.

uptime.description: Uptime is how long this surface has been mounted.

version.description: Version is the connected broker's server version; empty while degraded.

headers.description: Headers are the message headers, when any were published.

num_delivered.description: Delivered is how many times a consumer has been handed this message (pulls only).

num_pending.description: Remaining is how many messages follow this one for the consumer (pulls only).

sequence.description: Sequence is the message's stream sequence.

subject.description: Subject is the org-relative subject the message was stored under.

timestamp.description: Timestamp is when the broker stored the message.

filter.description: Filter purges only messages on this org-relative subject (wildcards supported).

keep.description: Keep retains that many newest messages.

name.description: Name is the stream name, from the path.

consumer_seq.description: Consumer is the consumer's own sequence.

stream_seq.description: Stream is the corresponding stream sequence.

bytes.description: Bytes is the total stored size.

consumer_count.description: Consumers is the number of consumers attached to this stream.

first_seq.description: FirstSeq is the sequence of the first stored message.

first_ts.description: FirstTS is the timestamp of the first stored message.

last_seq.description: LastSeq is the sequence of the last stored message.

last_ts.description: LastTS is the timestamp of the last stored message.

messages.description: Messages is the number of messages currently stored.

num_deleted.description: Deleted is the number of deleted messages (sequence gaps).

num_subjects.description: Subjects is the number of distinct subjects stored.

created.description: Created is when the stream was created.

name.description: Name is the stream name within the org.

state.description: State is the stream's current state.

streams.description: Streams is the page, ordered by name.

total.description: Total is the org's stream count before paging.

jetstream.description: JetStream is true when durable streams are enabled.

max_payload.description: MaxPayload is the broker's message-size ceiling in bytes.

server_id.description: Server is the broker's server id.

server_name.description: Name is the broker's server name.

streams.description: Streams is the org's stream count.

version.description: Version is the broker's server version.

stream.description: Stream is the stream name, from the path.

batch.description: Batch is how many messages to pull (1–1000, default 1).

expires.description: Expires is how long to wait for messages, e.g. "5s" (default "30s", max "60s").

name.description: Name is the consumer name, from the path.

no_wait.description: NoWait answers immediately with whatever is available instead of waiting.

stream.description: Stream is the stream name, from the path.

consumers.description: Consumers is the page, ordered by name.

total.description: Total is the stream's consumer count before paging.

purged.description: Purged is the number of messages removed.

messages.description: Messages is what was read, stream-ordered.
